Hi Ava,

We're kicking off a short PoC (NLP-driven feedback summaries for classroom essays) and need a clean baseline to budget. Can you share Redwood's standard per-1M token rates (input vs output) for hosted API, and a short list of supported models and their relative cost tiers?

A few details that matter for us:
- Expected burst: 2k reqs/day, peak concurrent <10
- Typical prompt length: ~1.2k input tokens, average generated output ~400 tokens
- We'll likely evaluate both larger Llama-family variants and a quieter cheaper opt model

Also interested in any standard volume discount thresholds (monthly committed tokens) and whether you separate input/output pricing for embeddings or just generation. If you can attach a one-page rate snapshot and an example PoC cost estimate, that'd be helpful.

We'd like to make a decision within two weeks. Thanks —

Hi Bryan — attached is a concise snapshot and a modeled PoC estimate for the usage profile you described. See the highlights below:

Attachments:
- redwood-hosted-ratecard-1m-io-v3.pdf (one-page rate snapshot)
- PoC-scope-and-estimates.xlsx (breakdown by model + commit scenarios)

Top-line (hosted API, USD, per 1M tokens):
- Input tokens: $0.80 per 1M
- Output tokens: $1.20 per 1M
Notes: We price input and output separately for generation; embeddings use a separate unit rate (see attached snapshot).

Model tiers (supported in hosted catalog):
- Premium (high-quality, higher compute): rwd-llamax-40b, rwd-llamax-13b
  - Relative cost: ~2.5x base rate
- Standard (balanced latency/cost): rwd-pegasus-7b, rwd-bison-6b
  - Relative cost: ~1.0x base rate
- Economical (quantized, lower cost): rwd-sparrow-4b-q4
  - Relative cost: ~0.45x base rate

Volume & discounts (hosted):
- 1–25M tokens/mo: list rates
- 25–250M tokens/mo: 8–12% volume discount (typical)
- 250M–1B tokens/mo: 18–25% (negotiated, requires commit)
- >1B tokens/mo: custom pricing, multi-quarter commit preferred

Other items that affect cost: batching profile, KV cache hit rate, and average sequence length. In the attached PoC workbook we've modeled your sample (1.2k in / 400 out) across the three model tiers and included a committed-month scenario for 100M tokens.

We can offer a standard PoC credit ($5k) for evaluation and a 30-day trial with limited throughput. If you plan to commit to a monthly minimum, we can outline a straightforward discount schedule and an SLA addendum for hosted.

If useful, Markus can jump on a short call to discuss model selection and latency trade-offs.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
